name: desktop_screen_find_image
description:
Search the screen (or a region) for a template image using pixel-level matching.

Returns all matches as a list of `{x, y, width, height, score}` objects.
`confidence` sets the minimum similarity threshold (0–1, default: 0.8).
Requires `@nut-tree-fork/template-matcher` to be installed.

templatePath.description: Absolute path to the PNG template image to search for

region.description: Restrict search to this screen region
